serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: There’s one problem though, I have no idea how to convince that bot to trust me. Her character is also not helping with it…
Shanice: No wonder it's hard. She’s probably protecting her owner. 
Shanice: I wish I could help, but I have no idea how to do it.
You: Thanks anyway. 
Shanice: No problem!
Shanice: Oh! You can always try asking your bot about it. She might have some ideas.
